items.title: Circular Dot Pattern Perforated CNC Screen File
items.description: A highly functional, minimalist industrial vector file featuring a clean, precise repeating pattern of interlocking large and small perforated circular dots. This high-density perforated layout is engineered in production-ready DXF, SVG, and DWG formats for flawless high-volume laser cutting, punch pressing, and CNC metal perforation. Perfectly suited for manufacturing architectural sunshades, HVAC radiator covers, ventilation grilles, acoustic panels, and dynamic modern space dividers.

items.title: Islamic Star Geometric Mashrabiya Panel Cutting File for CNC
items.description: Introduce timeless architectural elegance using this Islamic star geometric panel design. This traditional Mashrabiya-inspired pattern consists of precise interlocking diagonal lines and stylized starburst shapes, fully optimized in DXF, SVG, and DWG formats to prevent material breakage during cutting. Highly recommended for workshop owners fabricating suspended ceiling panels, modern room dividers, or outdoor facade cladding.
